run_summaries.notes: Initial hourly run. Focused on agro, industrial, and B2B marketplace builders in Mexico. Added accounts building local marketplaces, livestock media, CANACINTRA branch, horticulture magazine, agricultural producer, machinery rental, and avocado coverage.

Second run. Expanded to wood/carpentry, industrial projects, events, restaurant cost issues, livestock tech, traditional ganadería, industrial policy, direct producer support, avocado pests, and FIRA.

Third run. Covered agro media, national agro council, northwest producer interviews, Guanajuato entrepreneurship, livestock supports, export assistance for local sellers, Puebla animal welfare, and Agriculture Secretariat incentives.

Fourth run. Legislative protection for small producers, Sinaloa wheat payments, Querétaro ganadería architecture, Puebla synthesis media on pest protocols, and Sonora coverage of scaling food entrepreneur with restaurants. Prioritized diversity and genuine B2B relevance.

Fifth hourly run. Searches continued to yield mostly institutional, media and news coverage rather than individual small-business sellers or active buyers due to ongoing news cycles. Added 4 quality relevant accounts: coverage of artisan bread producers association in Morelos, extrusion consulting support for Mexican manufacturers, historic ganadería feature in Tlaxcala, and reporting on new animal welfare legislation relevant to veterinary sector. Focused on diversity and genuine potential interest in local B2B connections.

Sixth hourly run. Direct individual seller or buyer posts remain scarce amid news and institutional content. Added 3 high-quality relevant accounts: Director of Consejo Nacional Agropecuario on producer profitability and market access, national dairy producers association (AMLAC), and the leading Foro Global Agroalimentario connecting thousands of producers. Prioritized genuine B2B and association networks for feedback on local marketplace.

Seventh hourly run. Continued scarcity of direct individual small-business seller posts amid Día de Muertos and institutional news. Added 7 quality relevant accounts: automotive refacciones seller, Quadratín coverage of producer incentives, kontrapeso on avocado pest losses, CDMX Historic Center authority promoting local commerce, artisanal mezcal producer shipping nationwide, official Agriculture Secretariat announcement, and financial radar on local economic impact of seasonal celebrations. Prioritized diversity and genuine B2B relevance.

Eighth hourly run. Extremely low volume of qualifying individual small-account posts (<1000 followers) about selling/buying in agro, mechanical, vet, wood or local B2B. Most relevant recent activity is from media, associations or larger accounts. Added 1 solid candidate (473 followers) complaining about intermediaries harming Mexican producers — perfect fit for RedDirecta B2B value prop. Continued focus on quality and accessibility.
